worldcombat.skill.sunnyday.summary: Call harsh sunlight onto a chosen patch of sky: the sky clears; living targets in the field, friend or foe alike, hit harder with Fire moves and are sapped on Water moves, and their frozen bodies thaw and their soaked marks dry off. Rain and sun replace each other.
worldcombat.skill.sunnyday.description.0: Press a sunlight field of radius %1$s blocks onto the chosen ground, clearing the sky and reading the weather there as harsh sun, lasting %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.sunnyday.description.1: Living targets in the field with a clear line to its centre carry the sunlight mark, friend or foe alike; while marked, their Fire moves have x1.5 power and their Water moves x0.5, and it thaws frozen and dries off soaked. The mark lingers for %1$s after leaving, still working until it fades.
worldcombat.skill.sunnyday.description.2: Starts up in %1$s and settles in %2$s, both driven by Speed.
worldcombat.skill.sunnyday.timing: Cast at ground within %1$s blocks; after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to call the sun, recovers %3$s, then goes on a %5$s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.sunnyday.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown drops to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.sunnyday.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown drops again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.sunnyday.preference.bl: On = blazing: wider field (x1.2), longer warmth (x1.35), but shorter life (x0.78) and cooldown +18 ticks. Off = mild sun: smaller and shorter warmth, but lasts longer and cools down 12 ticks sooner.
worldcombat.skill.sunnyday.preference.ai: The companion only calls sunlight while a threat is within this distance; lower calls it up close, higher sets it up in advance.
Push the sun at the foe
On, the sun is called between you and the threat so the fighting line falls in the light; off, it is called at your feet to shield yourself first.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to call sunlight.
